scope: structure/BOS blind semantic audit infrastructure and synthetic tests only; no real case materialization, future reveal, action value, PnL or MBO

completed_candle_interpretation.synthetic_rule: a complete candle containing a registered synthetic minute advances causal market time but cannot change typed structure state or semantic age
completed_candle_interpretation.unknown_gap: terminalize pending BOS at the first known boundary, then hard reset
completed_candle_interpretation.contract_change: terminalize pending BOS at the first known boundary, then hard reset
completed_candle_interpretation.simultaneous_gap_and_contract_change: retain both anomaly codes, publish one typed terminal state per pending BOS with contract_change_reset, and advance reset_epoch once

passes: pass1 scans only reader and observer semantic state and atomically freezes the selection authority manifest
pass2 replays each frozen case from the same source prefix and requires the same event id, case clock and semantic state hash before rendering
selection.score: SHA-256 of score_bytes; retain the two lexicographically smallest scores in each bucket
selection.shortage_policy: unavailable; no cross-year, cross-direction or cross-class backfill
class_precedence: confirmed BOS with scope opposed is broken_or_opposed
pending BOS whose last_attempt_at equals case_clock is wick_only_no_close
selection.reviewable_context_gate: all four histories must be non-empty and contract-consistent; focal target/prior swing, pending clock, every wick-attempt clock, resolution and source structure must be causally materializable before a case can enter a bucket

artifact_separation.case_transaction: immutable authority and blind source files plus one completion marker; reviews can never be written here
artifact_separation.authority_manifest: contains the exact selection identity, full raw-recoverable typed truth and causal clock certificate; reviewer access forbidden
artifact_separation.blind_manifest: contains opaque identity, case clock, contract content hash and exact packet digests only
artifact_separation.blind_raw_evidence: all retained causal candle values, integer ticks, stable indices, source-prefix commitment and reset provenance; no selected truth
artifact_separation.blind_image: raw completed four-timeframe candles, integer-tick grid, stable indices, synthetic hatching and case-clock boundary only
artifact_separation.review_transaction: separate create-once root containing review.json and LOCKED_REVIEW.json
artifact_separation.reviewer_export: contains exactly the registered selection/Pass2 blind units and blind-set manifest; no authority file or link
artifact_separation.truth_overlay: may be produced only after every actual review transaction in the exact selection/Pass2 set is semantically revalidated
artifact_separation.scorecard: requires exactly one immutable truth overlay per registered review unit and directly computes the frozen 240-case gate

review_schema.enumeration_rule: enumerate every swing and BOS candidate recoverable from raw evidence; every wick-attempt index is chronological and there is no hidden focal judgment
review_schema.lock_policy: review roots are create-once and disjoint from immutable packet trees; exact packet and review semantics are revalidated before truth

release_gates.blind_strict_case_agreement: at least 216/240; missing and uncertain count as disagreement
